title: Jessica Simpson Updates Her Fashion Line for Fall as She Returns to Music & Preps New Documentary
summary: A lineup of sweater tops, faux fur & denim builds on Simpson’s fashion legacy at Walmart as she steps back into music after a 15-year hiatus.
body: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. There’s no shortage of ’70s inspiration in Jessica Simpson’s Walmart fashion line this fall. As summer comes to a close, the collection is making room for sweater tops, denim, faux-fur pieces and other seasonal staples, with prices starting at just $8. Simpson launched the Walmart line in 2024, adding an affordable option to the fashion empire she has built over the years. Her latest fall pieces feel like an easy way to ease into the new season without buying an entirely new wardrobe. A sweater can be layered over a summer dress, denim works with practically everything and faux fur can instantly make an outfit feel more fall-ready. title: Hilary Duff Reveals Why She Declared ‘I’m Going to Be a Pop Star’ After ‘Lizzie McGuire’
summary: "I'm going to make music and I'm going to get a record deal and I'm going to be a pop star," the 38-year-old manifested.
body: Hilary Duff didn’t just stumble into the world of pop stardom after becoming a Disney Channel star. She says she actively pursued music as a way to move beyond her beloved television persona. During a conversation with Drew Barrymore on The Drew Barrymore Show , Duff ruminated on the complicated experience of growing up in the public eye and being forever associated with Lizzie McGuire, the titular character she played on the Disney Channel series from 2001 to 2004. title: Looking Ahead: A Release Calendar of Upcoming Albums in 2026
summary: We'll be updating our list as musicians announce their new music, so keep checking back for the latest!
body: Keeping track of all the upcoming releases from favorite artists can sometimes be a bit of a challenge. It’s not unusual for musicians to tease an album, then reveal a release date, only for the LP to be delayed for one reason or another (in some cases, multiple times), often without a new release date attached. Then there are albums that are announced mere days before they drop! Related The 50 Best Albums of 2026 So Far (Staff Picks) But we’ve got you! Musicians from across genres started teasing new projects and announcing album release dates for the new year as it barely started. And like the last several trips around the sun, we’re keeping a calendar to keep track of all the notable releases of the year. One of the most highly anticipated releases was Hilary Duff’s Luck…or Something — her first album in 10 years — which dropped in February. The singer-actress first announced her return to music in September, when she revealed a new label deal with Atlantic Records, as well as new music and a docuseries that will follow her musical comeback. title: Simon Cowell to Undergo Surgery Amid ‘America’s Got Talent’ Live Shows, Celeb Guests to Fill in as Judges
summary: The mogul's procedure will cause him to miss several weeks of the series.
body: Simon Cowell will miss several weeks of America’s Got Talent ‘s live shows as he undergoes routine surgery on his back, Billboard can confirm. In his place, a lineup of celebrity guests — which AGT is still in the process of booking — will reportedly take over his spot as he receives the procedure and recovers. TMZ was the first to report the news. summary: The Severance star shared that he also earned some points with his daughter, who's a Swiftie.
body: Adam Scott has offered fans a fleeting glimpse of what it was like inside Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding, and according to the Severance star, the extravaganza was surprisingly down-to-earth. title: Ryan Beuschel Promoted to Co-Head of The Neal Agency
summary: The Nashville firm books Morgan Wallen, Riley Green and Ella Langley, among others.
body: Ryan Beuschel has been elevated to co-head of the Neal Agency (TNA) alongside Adi Sharma and founder/CEO Austin Neal . Beuschel had served as general manager since starting with the Nashville-based talent and publishing agency three years ago.
